description: Update webhook URL, subscribed events, description, active state, mailbox and domain filter, the Authorization header sent with deliveries, the Standard Webhooks signing secret, whether message.received carries reply_text, whether it skips senders that did not pass DMARC, or the senders it is limited to. A URL change redirects future deliveries. authorization and standard_webhooks_secret are write-only and never echoed back; null removes them.

allowed_senders.description: Replace the senders message.received is limited to: addresses or exact domains, at most 100. Null or [] delivers every sender again; omit to keep the list.

authenticated_senders_only.description: Skip message.received deliveries whose sender did not pass DMARC, or stop skipping them.

authorization.description: Replace the Authorization header sent with every delivery. Null removes it; omit to keep it. Write-only: never returned.

domain_ids.description: Replace the domain filter. Null or [] clears it.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. If omitted, the MCP server generates one for POST tools.

include_reply_text.description: Turn reply_text on message.received deliveries on or off. Turning it on needs the messages:read scope.

mailbox_ids.description: Replace the mailbox filter. Null or [] clears it.

standard_webhooks_secret.description: Replace the Standard Webhooks signing secret. Null stops the signatures; omit to keep it. Write-only: never returned.

name: shipmail_update_webhook

allowed_senders.description: Addresses and domains message.received is limited to. Null when every sender is delivered.

authenticated_senders_only.description: True when message.received is skipped for senders that did not pass DMARC.

has_authorization.description: True when deliveries carry an Authorization header. The value is never returned.

has_standard_webhooks_secret.description: True when deliveries carry Standard Webhooks signatures from a stored signing secret. The secret is never returned.

include_reply_text.description: True when message.received deliveries carry reply_text.

title: Update Webhook
